# Otix.ai

> Otix.ai publishes practical, field-tested writing on AI-assisted software delivery — spec-driven agent workflows, local coding agents, and the DONE delivery framework. Based in Des Moines, Iowa.

Everything here is long-form and written from real client and lab work rather than product marketing. Posts document what was actually run, what broke, and what the tradeoffs were.

## Blog

- [Three Local AI Agents Walk Into a Legacy Codebase](https://otix.ai/blog/local-llm-agents.html): Building an adversarial multi-agent refactoring loop with the `pi` coding agent and Ollama, running entirely locally on a 32GB M4 MacBook Air with no API costs. Covers model selection (Qwen3 Coder 30B MoE), agent prompt design, and why separate mandates produce adversarial behavior from a single model.

## Frameworks

- [DONE](https://otix.ai/): A delivery framework positioned as a practical alternative to SAFe — Deliver, Own, Navigate, Evolve. Outcomes over ceremonies. Manifesto forthcoming.
